name: contract-field-names
goal: Keep each contract field distinguishable when multiple functions use the same parameter name

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Four function-qualified inputs appear as identical Value rows on the Code name casing Contract tab.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing typed-contract unit and browser tests cover distinct field names only. Extend their shared declared fixture with four owners of value and assert distinct table labels and modal titles across revisions and viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 34d4a89c failed the existing contract unit test and all three browser widths: four indistinguishable Value rows. Checkpoint and test-owned before screenshots preserved.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Retain readable owner prefixes for colliding sibling names in the shared typed contract renderer; the same field label names its info button and modal.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
